press_references.value: Jazeera Airways extends Al-Qadsiya sponsorship for three years in landmark partnership

partnership_announcements.description: Jazeera Airways signed a new three-year strategic sponsorship agreement with Al-Qadsiya Sports Club, extending their prior sponsorship into a longer-term partnership that includes financial, logistical and media support.

press_references.value: Jazeera Airways hosts first Kuwait Tourism Forum to unlock the country’s tourism potential

partnership_announcements.description: Jazeera Airways and the Kuwait Hotel Owners Association signed a Memorandum of Understanding to collaborate between aviation and hospitality sectors in support of tourism development initiatives in Kuwait.

press_references.value: Sri Lanka, Jazeera Airways explore resumption of Kuwait–Colombo flights

partnership_announcements.description: Jazeera Airways and the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka are in high-level talks on a regulatory and operational collaboration to resume scheduled air services between Kuwait City and Colombo, potentially with onward connectivity to India.

press_references.value: Jazeera Airways inaugural flight lands at Amman City Airport

partnership_announcements.description: Jazeera Airways and Jordan Airport Company announced a new operational partnership as Jazeera became the first airline to operate direct scheduled commercial flights between Kuwait and Amman City Airport, supporting the airport’s reopening and long-term collaboration.

press_references.value: Jazeera Airways to become first carrier at Amman City Airport

partnership_announcements.description: Jazeera Airways and Jordan Airport Company signed a strategic MoU making Jazeera the first carrier to operate scheduled commercial flights from Amman City Airport, enhancing connectivity between Kuwait and Jordan.

press_references.value: Jazeera Airways takes off as Al-Qadisiya Club’s official carrier

partnership_announcements.description: Jazeera Airways was announced as the main sponsor and official carrier of Al-Qadisiya Club for the new season, highlighting a strategic partnership between the airline and the Kuwaiti sports club.

press_references.value: Jazeera Airways accelerates digital transformation journey with LitmusWorld’s NPS Solution

partnership_announcements.description: Jazeera Airways has partnered with LitmusWorld to launch a new Customer Experience and Feedback Intelligence Platform, marking LitmusWorld's entry into the Middle East aviation sector. Jazeera Airways has also partnered with Tata Consultancy Services to modernize its digital infrastructure and introduce an AI-driven chatbot.

press_references.value: Jazeera Airways in the market for more narrow-body jets to capture European traffic

partnership_announcements.description: Jazeera Airways and Kuwait Airways are considering a complementary partnership to expand their point-to-point network, similar to the Emirates and flydubai model.

press_references.value: Jazeera Airways partners with HTS to introduce game changing products first time in the Middle East

partnership_announcements.description: Jazeera Airways and HTS, the B2B division of Hopper, have announced a partnership to introduce Cancel For Any Reason (CFAR) and Disruption Assistance For Any Reason (DAFAR) products on Jazeera Airways' direct channels, marking the first launch of these fintech products in the Middle East.

about_short_description.short_description: Jazeera Airways is Kuwait's airline company.

product.name: Scheduled Passenger Air Travel
product.description: Scheduled domestic and international passenger flights operated by Jazeera Airways, with one-way, round-trip, and multi-city booking options from Kuwait and other served locations.

product.name: Jazeera Air Cargo
product.description: Air cargo transportation for moving goods through Jazeera Airways’ cargo service, supporting shipment arrangements separately from passenger bookings.

product.name: Travel Packages
product.description: Pre-arranged travel packages that combine selected flight-related services and optional travel benefits for customers booking a Jazeera Airways journey.

product.name: Ancillary Travel Services
product.description: Optional services that can be added to a flight, including advance seat selection, meals, extra baggage, travel insurance, cancellation protection, disruption assistance, and fare-price protection.

product.name: Online Booking and Trip Management
product.description: Digital tools for searching and purchasing flights, managing reservations, checking in online, and viewing flight status using a booking reference and passenger details.

product.name: Jazeera Airways Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile application for making bookings, managing trips, accessing exclusive fares, and receiving real-time flight updates while traveling.
